title: Figure 6: Implant location - electrode sites across neocortical layers
description: Cartoon diagram showing a reference electrode shaft with numbered sites 1-16 alongside cortical layers I-VI divided into "Upper" and "Lower" sections with a "separation boundary," followed by eight angled electrode shafts labeled D2-Left, D2-Right, D3-Left, D3-Right, D1-Left, D4-Right and D4-Left. The caption "Figure 6. Implant Location" explains the gray band is the 200µm separation region between upper and lower layers of the neocortex. Accompanying text covers chronic neural implants and fMRI.
